Bug_Title: Child class methods named for parent class methods should be overrides
Bug_Explanation: Child class methods named for parent class methods should be overrides, but they are not due to incorrect method signatures and static methods.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case testShowBug calls the showBug method from the Parent class. This method creates a Child object and calls its doSomething() and doSomethingElse() methods. Since the Child class methods do not properly override the Parent class methods (due to incorrect method signatures and the use of static), the Parent class methods are called instead, triggering the bug.
